about.title: About MilkyWayyy Cinema
about.p1: is one of the first private cinema companies established in 2026, confirming the brand as one of the top 10 most favorite entertainment locations. In addition to the modern cinema system, attracting millions of viewers, MilkyWayyy Cinema also attracts audiences with a friendly atmosphere and top service quality.
about.p2: Coming to milkywayyy.me, customers will easily refer to the best, latest movies currently playing or coming soon that are always updated regularly. The showtimes at all of MilkyWayyy Cinema's cinema systems are also updated fully every day and every hour on the homepage.
about.p3: Now booking tickets at MilkyWayyy Cinema is even easier with just a few simple steps. To buy tickets, go to the Buy Tickets tab. You can choose to Buy tickets by movie, by cinema, or by date. Then, proceed to buy tickets following the instructions.
about.p4: If you have chosen a good movie to watch, book tickets super fast with the Quick Ticket Box right from the Homepage. In just one minute, MilkyWayyy Cinema's response text and email will be sent right to your phone and mailbox.
about.promo: MilkyWayyy Cinema always has attractive promotions, offers, and gifts for customers.
about.p5: The milkywayyy.me website also has a Cinema Corner - where database of movies, actors and directors are stored, specialized articles on cinema, helping movie lovers more easily in choosing movies.

policy.hero_desc: At MilkyWayyy, your privacy is our top priority. We are committed to protecting your personal information absolutely.
policy.footer_quote: We believe transparency is the foundation of trust. Every data processing at MilkyWayyy is towards the highest safety for customers.

sections.s1_content: The collection of data on the MilkyWayyy website includes: Email, phone number, username, login password, customer address. This is the information that MilkyWayyy needs customers to provide compulsorily when registering to use the service and for MilkyWayyy to contact for confirmation when customers register to use the service on the website to ensure the rights of consumers.
sections.s2_content: The company uses information provided by customers to: Provide services to customers; Send notifications about information exchange activities between customers and MilkyWayyy; Prevent activities that destroy customer user accounts or customer impersonation activities; Contact and resolve with customers in special cases.
sections.s3_content: Customers' personal data will be stored until there is a request for cancellation or customers log in and perform cancellation. Otherwise, in all cases, customers' personal information will be kept confidential on MilkyWayyy's server.
sections.s4_content: We are committed not to sell or share leading to the disclosure of your personal information for commercial purposes. However, we may provide information to authorities if there is a legal requirement or to protect MilkyWayyy's legitimate interests.
sections.s5_content: Customers have the right to self-check, update, adjust or cancel their personal information by logging into the account and editing personal information or requesting MilkyWayyy to do this.
sections.s6_content: This policy may change to suit the development of the service and legal regulations. Any changes will be announced publicly on our website.

terms.hero_desc: Welcome to MilkyWayyy. Please read the terms below carefully to ensure the best interests when experiencing our service.
terms.footer_disclaimer: By continuing to use the website, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms. MilkyWayyy has the right to update these terms at any time without prior notice.

sections.s1_content: By accessing and using the MilkyWayyy website, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions set forth herein. If you do not agree with any terms, please stop using our service immediately.
sections.s2_title: 2. Regulations on ticket booking and service use
sections.s2_content: Customers must provide accurate personal information when registering as a member. Tickets purchased through the MilkyWayyy system will be confirmed via email. Customers please present the ticket code at the counter or ticket checking machine to enter the screening room.
sections.s3_content: All payment transactions on the website are made through reputable payment gateways. Successfully purchased tickets ARE NOT refundable or exchangeable, except in cases where the showtime is canceled by MilkyWayyy.
sections.s4_content: Users are not allowed to use any tools or software to interfere with the system or change the data structure. All acts of spreading malicious information, contrary to fine customs or violating Vietnamese law are strictly prohibited.
sections.s5_content: All content on the website including design, logo, text, images are owned by MilkyWayyy. Any act of copying or quoting without our written consent is considered a violation.
sections.s6_content: Any disputes arising from the use of the service will be prioritized to be resolved through negotiation. If an agreement cannot be reached, the case will be taken to the competent authority for resolution in accordance with the law.

faq.hero_desc: Have questions? We have answers. Quickly find solutions to the most common problems at MilkyWayyy.
faq.cta_desc: Our support team is always ready to help you 24/7.

questions.q1_q: How to register a MilkyWayyy account?
questions.q1_a: Just click on the Login button on the toolbar, then select 'Register Now'. Fill in your personal information and confirm via email to start experiencing the service.
questions.q2_q: What should I do if I forget my password?
questions.q2_a: At the Login form, choose 'Forgot password'. The system will ask you to enter Email and send an OTP confirmation code so you can reset a new password.
questions.q3_a: Absolutely secure. MilkyWayyy applies the highest data encryption standards and is committed not to share your information with any third party without consent.
questions.q4_q: How many tickets can I book at most in one transaction?
questions.q4_a: To ensure fairness and avoid speculation, each account can book a maximum of 8 tickets for each showtime.
questions.q5_q: Which payment methods does the system support?
questions.q5_a: We support payment through popular gateways such as: MoMo Wallet, VNPay, domestic ATM cards and international cards (Visa, Mastercard).
questions.q6_q: How do I know if I have successfully booked tickets?
questions.q6_a: After payment, the system will display the QR ticket code right on the screen and simultaneously send detailed information to your Email. You can also check again in the 'Booking History' section in Profile.
questions.q7_q: Can I bring food from outside into the cinema?
questions.q7_a: According to general regulations, customers are requested not to bring outside food and drinks into the cinema to ensure hygiene and common space.
questions.q8_q: How to apply a discount code?
questions.q8_a: At the payment step, you will see the 'Enter discount code' box. Fill in your code there and press apply, the system will automatically deduct before you proceed to payment.
questions.q9_q: How early should I arrive at the cinema to receive my tickets?
questions.q9_a: We encourage you to arrive at the cinema at least 15-20 minutes before to perform ticket checking procedures and buy popcorn and drinks, ensuring you don't miss the beginning of the movie.
